result.summary: The validator passes its focused test, but the new configuration field never controls shutdown behavior.

findings.title: Wire the new timeout into the shutdown drain
findings.body: A supported value such as shutdown_drain_timeout=120.5 is accepted and persisted but silently ignored. scheduler.py:70–81 still initializes the timeout solely from the environment or a hardcoded 60 seconds, and line 634 uses that constant. With no environment override, shutdown therefore forces resource closure after 60 seconds even when the configured grace period is longer. The new validation itself is sound; the defect is the missing consumer.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the drain timeout from settings.general.shutdown_drain_timeout at shutdown, applying the environment override afterward. Add an integration test proving that a nondefault configured value reaches asyncio.timeout.

next_steps: Connect the configuration field to the scheduler and test configuration/environment precedence.
